# 03 — Create a domain glossary

## Objective
Draft a glossary for terms visible in the fictional application.
## Required context and areas
Inspect notice models, controller actions, views, tests, and `docs/baseline`.
## Change constraints
Create/update glossary documentation only. Do not introduce real maritime terminology or claim policy authority.
## Response format
Term, candidate definition, source evidence, confidence, conflicting use, and SME confirmation needed.
## Assumptions
Mark ambiguous words such as “publication”, “approval”, and “emergency” as candidates, not facts.
## Validation and evidence
Verify each definition against a source location and record the human review state. Report commands actually run.
